span.p:
Event flow: services publish BucketInvalidated after commit.
The queue coalesces duplicate keys.
The worker recomputes each key and writes one BucketAggregate row.
Admin change and audit record share one transaction (Transaction port, shown as a field).
DailySweep is the safety net for events lost in a crash.
PriceEntry and PriceBucket logic never touch a repository.
